content: pytest 9.1.1 (PyPI, 2026-06-19). @pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason='...') — unexpected XPASS fails the suite (verified live: FAILED [XPASS(strict)], exit 1); failing body shows XFAIL green. xfail_strict=true ini option exists. Parametrized xfail works. pytest.approx(expected, rel=...) verified. Pitfall found live: pytest 9 treats UNUSED parametrize argnames as a collection ERROR ('function uses no argument'). Config via [tool.pytest.ini_options] in pyproject.toml; pythonpath ini option adds import roots.
